findings: 374 successful NPU requests comprise 17 prewarm draws, 303 live draws and 54 live clears. All successful completions have relay acknowledgements. One additional request fails compilation and receives a failure acknowledgement.

Four 1024x768 frames arrive while the indirect display is the sole active path. The fourth visibly contains the Start menu. It arrives at 01:59:37.269067 UTC, 225.432 seconds after the Windows key and 25.211 seconds after Escape. This verifies a received Start image, not responsive input or a completed open/close interaction. The automated input report deliberately does not infer visual success from changed bytes.

The earlier third frame shows wallpaper and desktop icons. The fourth also shows a correctly repositioned taskbar. The ordinary display had been 1280x800 before switching to 1024x768, so resizing remains a confounding source of work.

DWM sequence 163 performs 11,533 NPU requests over 1,679 raster batches and takes 55.477 seconds of draw time. Its total including construction is 56.672 seconds. Small device submissions remain a major performance target.

DWM sequence 227 fails Intel NPU compilation with an unresolved NHWC materialization at 4096 lanes. The preserved original capture contains a new exact 1041-word three-texture shader, SHA256 39799859d6531970077cbe235484fb7164778b325f8f58e3b8d6774351baf0b3. It is not the previously capped 1061-word variant.

The observer stops on the recorded DWM rejection after 296663 ms. Topology restoration takes 10893 ms; both custom drivers and stream configuration are removed successfully. Worker exit 1 follows stream socket closure. Explorer also records later driver rejection status 88760870; successful frame receipt does not establish complete application health.
Live draw_ms sums to 188693.298 and compile_and_draw_ms to 276395. These sums use a different request mix than v104 and cannot establish an overall performance comparison.

Windows processes run in the disposable VM; the physical Panther Lake NPU performs accepted rendering operations. Frame presentation uses the Mac SDL viewer. Physical Delta scanout, general application coverage, full desktop offload and Tahoma benefit remain unverified.
